msg: BLOCK: FROM newline-collapse bypass. tic.sh:16 / tics-mcp.cjs:206 compare the RAW from to the hook ids, then _tic_esc (tics-lib.sh:15) strips CR/LF, so FROM=$'run-suite\n' (or 'run-\rsuite') is stored as from=run-suite. Via tic.sh it works with kind=signal result=green, which is a forged hook-signed green. Fix: reject any CR/LF/control char in FROM/TO/KIND before the reserved check (tic.sh and the MCP), or check the escaped value in emit_tic. Next test: I5, tic.sh with FROM=$'run-suite\n' gives rc 2 and no stored tic has from run-suite (same for the MCP).
